 Press Release: Lofgren, Amo Seek Answers on NOAA GeoXO Satellite Program After GAO Report
 By: Quiver CongressRadar
 Posted: 7 hours ago / Oct. 20, 2026 12:20 a.m. UTC 
 Lofgren and Amo criticize NOAA satellite cuts, citing a GAO report warning of reduced weather and climate forecasting capabilities.
 Quiver AI Summary
 Lofgren and Amo seek answers on satellite program: House Democrats Zoe Lofgren and Gabe Amo said they sent a letter to NOAA Administrator Neil Jacobs about the GeoXO weather satellite program, which is intended to replace the current fleet in the 2030s. They said a GAO report found that recent changes put “vital observations at risk.”
 Lawmakers criticize proposed cuts: The members said the Trump administration sought to cut the program by 50% in 2025 and focus only on “weather data needs.” Their letter argues the changes could leave future satellites “no better — or even worse” than current ones, while NOAA is urged to keep the program on track.
